English

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (US) IPA(key): /ˈdʌbəlju.læn/ or like wireless LAN
  • Audio (US):(file)
  • Audio (Southern England):(file)

Noun

[edit]

WLAN (plural WLANs)

  1. Initialism of wireless local area network.

See also

[edit]
  • Wi-Fi

Anagrams

[edit]
  • Waln, lawn, nawl, Lawn

Finnish

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

WLAN

  1. alternative letter-case form of wlan (“WLAN”)
